name: Erion Shadewhisper
summary: Jannok Breezesong sends promising rogues from Teldrassil to Darnassus. At the Cenarion Enclave, Erion Shadewhisper points them toward work beyond the forests.

sections.title: A Summons to the Enclave
sections.body: Jannok Breezesong sends you from Teldrassil to find Erion Shadewhisper in Darnassus. You need not worry about being sent to the exacting trainer Syurna. Erion waits in the Cenarion Enclave, where he handles work that calls for a quieter touch.

sections.title: Eyes on the Horizon
sections.body: Erion Shadewhisper marks a change for rogues in night elf lands. Teldrassil's forests can no longer contain your duties. Erion sends capable hands into a wider, more dangerous world, toward work across the sea.

faq.q: Who sends you to find Erion Shadewhisper?
faq.answer: Jannok Breezesong sends you to Darnassus to speak with Erion Shadewhisper at the Cenarion Enclave.
Erion Shadewhisper is in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus, among the trees on the enclave's upper tiers.
Syurna is a prominent rogue trainer in Darnassus, known for stern and demanding lessons. Jannok reassures you with a lighthearted quip that you are not in trouble or being sent to her for training.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Erion?
faq.answer: After your report, Erion gives you his next task, Erion's Behest, and sends you beyond Teldrassil to broaden your reach in Kalimdor.

faq.q: What kind of work does Erion oversee?
faq.answer: Erion directs new rogues in Darnassus and connects local agents with wider Alliance operations.

faq.q: Why is a rogue handler stationed in the Cenarion Enclave?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Enclave is known for druids and nature worship. Its trees offer secluded places for stealthy agents to meet and conduct business away from the Temple of the Moon.

angles.text: As a rogue, you leave novice work on Teldrassil and report to Erion Shadewhisper for work that calls for finesse beyond the starting forests.
As a night elf shadow-stalker, you report to Erion in Darnassus as you move from local warding to wider duties across the continent.
As an Alliance operative in northern Kalimdor, you coordinate with Darnassus handlers before venturing into contested territory.
